notes: Browse the shop with no account: products, stores and reviews are open on a fresh install, and sign-in is asked for only when you add to cart, buy, or open your profile
The sign-in form now opens above the page you were on and closes itself, so signing in returns you to the product and finishes what you tapped
Code screens (new device, e-mail confirmation, password reset) are no longer hidden behind the sign-in form
The three-slide intro is gone — the app opens straight on the storefront
Product image dots no longer overflow on small cards
